# Peak Player Platform — AI Agent Index

> Version 2026-10-28 · GitHub: https://github.com/pansiluchethiya/peak-player

## Quick Start
- Docs: https://docs.peak-player.com
- API: https://api.peak-player.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/pansiluchethiya/peak-player
- MCP server: `mcp/` (stdio transport, read-only repository access)

## Full Documentation (AI-Optimized)
The complete AI docs are available at `docs/llms-full.txt` (concatenated content of all `docs/content/docs/ai/*.mdx` files).
AI docs index:
- `ai/quickstart.mdx` — Mint a session, mount the player, listen for events
- `ai/concepts.mdx` — Sources, validation, ranking, failover, embed boundary
- `ai/guides/embedding.mdx` — Partner integration (SDK + postMessage)
- `ai/guides/auth.mdx` — API keys, signed tokens, origin allowlists, expiry
- `ai/guides/live-tv.mdx` — HLS channels, health checks, failover
- `ai/guides/player-controls.mdx` — Commands (play, pause, seek, etc.)
- `ai/guides/preferences.mdx` — Preference modes and persistence
- `ai/guides/theming.mdx` — Design tokens, accent, dark/light
- `ai/guides/playback.mdx` — Source resolution, failover, ABR
- `ai/reference/sdk.mdx` — PeakEmbed JS API and lifecycle events
- `ai/reference/urls.mdx` — API endpoint reference
- `ai/reference/postmessage.mdx` — postMessage protocol
- `ai/api-reference.mdx` — Full HTTP API reference
- `ai/self-hosting.mdx` — Docker + npm + pnpm install
- `ai/architecture.mdx` — Architecture diagram and component map
- `ai/security.mdx` — Token signing, SSRF guards, CSP

## Key Files
- `providers/rive.js` — Provider integration (PRIME/STELLAR/NEXUS/ORBIT)
- `utils/embedToken.js` — Token signing/verification (AES-256-GCM)
- `utils/playerService.js` — Stream resolution and source ranking
- `utils/adminConfig.js` — Admin config DB CRUD (feature toggles, tokens, proxies)
- `routes/adminConfigRoutes.js` — Admin API routes for config/tokens/proxies
- `apiServer.js` — Express API server entry point
- `proxy/proxyServer.js` — Media proxy with signed URLs
- `player/src/lib/servers.ts` — Provider codename map
- `player/src/app/page.tsx` — Landing page (MagicUI)
- `player/src/lib/api.ts` — Player API client

|---|---|

| `rive vanguard` | STELLAR |
| `rive pulse` | NEXUS |
| `rive citadel` | ORBIT |
| `netmirror` | NOVA |

| `vidlink` | ORION |

| `showbox` | MERIDIAN |

## Services
| Service | Port | App type |
|---|---|---|
| API server | 8787 | Node.js + Express |
| Player | 3001 | Next.js |
| Docs | 3002 | Next.js + fumadocs |
| Admin | 3003 | Next.js + fumadocs-ui |
| MCP server | n/a | stdio |
